recommendations.title: The Mitchells vs. The Machines
recommendations.description: A quirky animated film about a mismatched family that embarks on a road trip just as a robot apocalypse begins.
recommendations.tagline: Family. Robots. Apocalypse. What could go wrong?

recommendations.title: Murder Mystery
recommendations.description: A New York City couple goes on a long-awaited trip to Europe, but their vacation takes a wild turn when they get embroiled in a murder investigation.
recommendations.tagline: A whodunit with plenty of laughs and a dash of adventure.

recommendations.title: The Wrong Missy
recommendations.description: After a disastrous blind date, a man ends up on a corporate retreat with the woman of his dreams—who happens to be his blind date from hell.
recommendations.tagline: One date can ruin your vacation... or make it unforgettable!
